annotation.title_clean: South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy Framework (Towards the Development of South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy)
annotation.title_en: South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy Framework (Towards the Development of South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT), Republic of South Africa
annotation.venue: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
annotation.summary_en: October 2024 consultation draft of South Africa's National AI Policy Framework from the DCDT. It uses a Futures Triangle analysis to set objectives and strategic pillars covering talent, infrastructure, R&D, ethics, privacy, security, transparency, fairness and human oversight. It is a first step toward AI regulation and possibly an AI Act. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework is the foundation for a National AI Policy and potentially a future AI Act
Twelve strategic pillars including talent, digital infrastructure, R&D funding, and public sector AI
Ethical AI guidelines, bias mitigation, and a code of conduct for AI professionals
Human-in-the-loop oversight for critical decisions, especially generative AI
